property_summary: The oracle() view must be caller-independent: it returns the same stored oracle address no matter who calls it; the mutant returns msg.sender instead, so different callers observe different oracle() values.
change_summary: Return the caller's address cast to IOracleProvider instead of the stored oracle address, so oracle() returns a different address value.
mutated_unit_code: function oracle() public view returns (IOracleProvider) { return IOracleProvider(msg.sender); }
